This bean plot is small, and for beans I usually do not spend money on chemical fertilizer because it is costly and we save that more for maize. I will plant my own local seed, use some manure if I can get it, and depend on the rains because we do not irrigate here. Most of the work will be done by my family, and I do not expect to hire much labor for this plot.
